name: Emma Virginia Bell (McKeldin)
notable_stories: She passed away very shortly after her granddaughter Barbara was born
Her death marked the beginning of a rapid series of losses in the McKeldin household
My paternal grandmother was Emma Bell McKeldin. She passed away right after I was born. (Barbara's memoir p. 57)
milestones: Religion: A regular churchgoer. Her son Buckey went with her every Sunday without fail. She does not appear to have been Catholic.
Buried at Mount Olivet Cemetery, Baltimore, 7 Jan 1949
sources: Barbara McKeldin Adams, "Barbara McKeldin Adams - A Memoir" (privately printed)
notes: Referenced in Barbara Jeanne Adams: Granddaughter of Emma Bell McKeldin
Grandmother to Barbara and Chuck McKeldin.

Born Emma Virginia Bell on 13 Aug 1891 in Baltimore, the daughter of William H. Bell and Elmira "Ella" Bell; the 1920 census lists her parents living with her and Charles at 1143 Carroll Street as his father-in-law and mother-in-law. Bell was her maiden name.

CORRECTION: died 4 Jan 1949 in Baltimore and buried 7 Jan 1949 at Mount Olivet Cemetery (Find a Grave, with burial permit number), about eleven months after her granddaughter Barbara was born; the earlier "abt Feb 1948" was an estimate from Barbara's memoir.

Married Charles Edward McKeldin about 1908 (he was 21 at his first marriage, per the 1930 census). Children in the 1920 and 1930 censuses: Lola E. (b. abt 1909), Lillian M. (abt 1911), Helen M. (abt 1912), Charles E. (1917), Emma (abt 1920) and William (abt 1923).
In the 1940 census she is listed as head of the household at 1143 Carroll Street, married, with her children Charles (23), Emma (19) and William (17); her husband Charles was not living there.
